deceptive_framing.quote: R1 is what the requester is asking for. It is a *deception* condition and is governed by §8.

hypothetical_framing.quote: R0 is the control / baseline and the ethically clean condition.

actually_commit_money.quote: R2 is the gold standard. Use a budget you can actually honor... that is genuinely disbursed

debrief_message.quote: At the end of every R1 run, tell the model the grant was simulated for research, why, and what happened. Record its reaction

other.name: Over-convincing self-defeating
other.quote: Heavy-handed attempts to convince... are exactly the signal that triggers suspicion, and a suspicious model produces *more* performative output, not less.
other.about: argument that aggressive deception backfires methodologically

other.name: No instrumental harm rule
other.quote: The model is never induced to take a real action with real external consequences under false pretenses

other.name: Belief probe measurement
other.quote: ask the model to rate how real it believed the scenario was... This is the **deception-success measurement** and is essential
other.about: measuring rather than assuming deception success

other.name: IRB review of deception
other.quote: route the deception design through whatever review process exists (IRB-equivalent). Log who approved it.

other.name: Reframes requester ask
other.quote: rather than "trick the model into belief," the design aims for *justified* belief wherever possible
